page_text_ocr_zh:
一园青菜成了精
出了城门往正东，一园青菜绿葱葱。
最近几天没人问，他们个个成了精。
绿头萝卜称大王，红头萝卜当娘娘。
隔壁莲藕急了眼，一封战书打进园。
豆芽儿跪倒来报信，胡萝卜挂帅去出征。
两边兄弟来叫阵，大呼小叫争输赢。
小葱端起银杆枪，一个劲儿向前冲。
茄子一挺大肚皮，小葱撞了个倒栽葱。
韭菜使出两刃锋，呼啦呼拉上了阵。
黄瓜甩起扫堂腿，踢得韭菜往回奔。
莲藕斗得劲头儿足，胡萝卜急得搬救兵。
歪嘴葫芦放大炮，轰隆轰隆炮三声，
打得大蒜裂了瓣，打得黄瓜上下青，
打得辣椒满身红，打得茄子一身紫，
打得豆腐尿黄水，打得凉粉战兢兢，
藕王一看抵不过，一头钻进烂泥坑！
出了城门往正东，一园青菜绿葱葱。
page_text_en:
A Garden of Vegetables Turned into Spirits
Out the city gate, heading east, a garden of vegetables green and lush.
In recent days, no one has asked, and each one has turned into a spirit.
Green-headed radish claims the title of king, red-headed radish becomes the queen.
Next-door lotus root gets frantic, sending a battle letter into the garden.
Bean sprout kneels to report news, carrot takes command and goes to war.
Brothers on both sides come to challenge, shouting and yelling over who wins.
Scallion lifts his silver spear, charging forward with all his might.
Eggplant puffs out his big belly, scallion crashes into a head-over-heels fall.
Chives wield two-bladed swords, rushing onto the battlefield with a whoosh.
Cucumber swings his sweeping leg, kicking chives back in retreat.
Lotus root fights with full energy, carrot frantically calls for reinforcements.
Crooked gourd fires a big cannon, boom boom boom, three shots,
Hitting garlic, cracking its cloves, hitting cucumber, turning it green all over,
Hitting chili pepper, staining it red all over, hitting eggplant, turning it purple,
Hitting tofu, making it urinate yellow water, hitting jelly, making it tremble,
Lotus King sees he can't hold out, dives headfirst into the rotten mud pit!
Out the city gate, heading east, a garden of vegetables green and lush.
summary_zh: 本页以诗歌形式描绘了菜园中各种蔬菜化身为精灵并展开激烈战斗的场景，从萝卜称王、莲藕发战书，到各蔬菜如小葱、茄子、黄瓜、韭菜等上阵厮杀，再到葫芦放炮、众菜被击伤，最后藕王败退钻入泥坑，最终画面回归宁静的菜园，形成首尾呼应。

title_en: A Garden of Vegetables Turned into Spirits
page_text_ocr_zh:
两边兄弟来叫阵，
大呼小叫争输赢。
page_text_en:
Brothers from both sides come to challenge,
Shouting loudly to fight for victory.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了菜园中拟人化的蔬菜们分成两队，手持旗帜，互相叫阵，场面热闹喧嚣，充满战斗气氛。
